summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Meld Phase Transition Modal + updated Meld Pill label + settlement-cutscene additions (canteensweep/breakyoself/chopper) regression. All PRIMARY new features PASS: (A) [data-testid=meld-phase-modal] appears BEFORE Book 1 with items ([data-testid=meld-phase-item-0..4]) and total ([data-testid=meld-phase-total]=63 observed). It pauses the engine (Book counter stays at 1/25 while modal is open — verified over 800ms window). It auto-dismisses after exactly 3.50s (measured), matching the ~3.5s spec. It also dismisses immediately when the [data-testid=meld-phase-continue-btn] is clicked. (B) [data-testid=meld-pill] on 1920x800 desktop viewport reads 'PapaCap Meld: 0 pts' — bidder-name + 'Meld: N pts' format, matches spec. (C) Chopper asset intentionally missing was confirmed on disk (/app/frontend/public/assets/cutscenes/ has no get2_chopper.*); CutsceneOverlay has three defensive guards (onError→finish, 2s loadTimer, capTimer) so a game-over path will not freeze. (D) Regression: no console errors during two full hands; auction/trump/discard/play/settlement all resolve; renege-bust settlement modal renders correctly with transfers and Next-Hand button; existing cutscene skip infra (from iter15/16) unchanged. Canteensweep (G2-makes-contract) and breakyoself (AI-bidder-hard-set) are probabilistic and were not organically observed in a random session — expected per request; the underlying settlement paths were exercised without hangs.
critical_code_review_comments: MeldPhaseModal (Modals.jsx:733-791) implements the 3.5s auto-dismiss via setTimeout + a visual progress bar; verified elapsed 3.50s in-browser. Uses e.stopPropagation on the panel and onClick on the backdrop so both click-continue-btn and click-anywhere dismissal paths work.
useGame.js correctly gates auto-play with `meldReveal` in the pause dependency (useGame.js:248) — engine truly stops while the modal is open, verified via trick-counter not advancing.
CutsceneOverlay has a robust triple-guard against missing files (onError, 2s loadTimer, capTimer) — the intentionally-missing get2_chopper.webm/mp4 asset will safely auto-skip.

meld-pill desktop label (Table.jsx:282) uses SEAT_LABEL[s.bidWinner] + ' Meld: ' + pillTotal + ' pts' — matches spec. Mobile pill (Table.jsx:174) still shows compact 'Np' format which is intentional for space, worth noting for consistency but not a bug.
CUTSCENE_FILE map now has 10 entries; banner text and file names align. All 10 present webm+mp4 files verified on disk; only chopper (11th) is deliberately absent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the deterministic checks (meld modal appears/pauses/auto-dismisses/click-dismisses, meld-pill label, no crash, no console errors). Canteensweep + Breakyoself cutscenes were not organically triggered in a random session, expected per problem statement.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Fast path to reach MeldPhaseModal: cfg-difficulty-hard → cfg-speed-fast → deal-btn → loop spamming pass-btn / trump-S / confirm-discard-btn / first-playable card in [data-testid=player-hand]. Modal reliably appears at play-phase entry with data-testid=meld-phase-modal, items 0..N-1, meld-phase-total, meld-phase-continue-btn. Measure auto-dismiss ≈ 3.5s. Backdrop click uses onClick on outer div (page.mouse.click(10,10)); panel uses stopPropagation. For canteensweep/breakyoself/chopper — do NOT block; they are rare/game-over paths. To force chopper you would need to drive G2's bankroll to $0, which takes many hands.
rca of the issue: N/A — all requested new features work correctly.
